grid=[list(map(int,l.split())) for l in grid_txt.splitlines()]
from collections import deque
R=C=16; seen=set(); comps=[]
for r in range(R):
 for c in range(C):
  if grid[r][c]!=7 and (r,c) not in seen:
   q=deque([(r,c)]); seen.add((r,c)); cells=[]
   while q:
    x,y=q.popleft(); cells.append((x,y))
    for nx,ny in ((x+1,y),(x-1,y),(x,y+1),(x,y-1)):
     if 0<=nx<R and 0<=ny<C and grid[nx][ny]!=7 and (nx,ny) not in seen:
      seen.add((nx,ny));q.append((nx,ny))
   vals=sorted({grid[x][y] for x,y in cells if grid[x][y] not in (0,7)})
   comps.append((min(x for x,y in cells),max(x for x,y in cells),min(y for x,y in cells),max(y for x,y in cells),len(cells),vals,cells))
for a in comps: print(a[:6])
